notes.note: In the actual browser the focused Project card stayed above overlapping pins while tabbing between Drag, Resize and Remove. The exact Remove hit, stored pin deletion and Undo, bulk cleanup and Undo, reload, and current Task lookup passed on the isolated Station. The actual cleanup POST returned 503 before its request authority binding was added.
Reviewed the guide link after the browser confirmed Open workspace and Add pane open the Work Board. The guide continues to cover that normal entry.

The only branch addition binds the existing request principal to POST /api/spatial-board/cleanup so the personal Board's configured resolver can read owner projections as the caller. This matches GET /api/spatial-board/resolved and leaves other routes, ownership, and admission intact. The browser caught the missing binding with a 503 and passed after the binding.
